Alex M.: Quick run-up of model v0.3-int8 across us-east / us-west / eu-west on H100 vs A100. Config: batch=1, seq=512, quant=int8. H100 us-east p50=38ms p95=94ms; A100 us-east p50=52ms p95=130ms. EU-west H100 p50=45ms p95=210ms when routed via eu-edge-proxy — see grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/yr7L-edge-latency

Priya S.: Can you paste the exact bench command + kernel? Did you fully warm the kv cache? Last sweep we saw kernel choice + cold cache blow up p95.

Alex M.: kernel=attn_v2_fused, warmup=100 requests. k6 snippet I used:

````
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 1m ./scripts/bench.js --out influx
// bench.js: batch=1, seq=512, model=v0.3-int8
````

CSV export: https://s3.redwood.internal/bench/1718012345.csv

Sam K.: That x2 p95 in eu-west smells like extra hop + proxy CPU saturation. Edge-proxy can add ~40-120ms tail when CPU >70%. Suggest: run canary that pins routing to regional-pop (no edge proxy) for eu-west and compare p95.

Elena G.: Agreed. Traces show many cache misses (prefix/KV) hitting the decode path repeatedly. Increasing per-pop warmup concurrency 5->20 previously shaved ~60ms off p95. Also try smaller initial batch to avoid head-of-line in the proxy.

Priya S.: Also queue a quant-quality eval on the same prompt set so we don't accidentally regress. int8->int4 will change perf but might drop quality; need diff on the eval harness (conv-regen). Eval job: https://evals.redwood.ai/run/4532

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: eu-edge-proxy v2.1 -> canary 10% at 2024-08-09T11:20Z by @Sam K.

Sam K.: I'll flip the routing policy for eu-west canary now:

````
curl -XPOST https://config.redwood.ai/api/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG" -d '{"region":"eu-west","edge_enabled":false,"canary":true,"pct":10}'
// see runbook: /runbooks/edge-routing-canary.md
````

Alex M.: Action items:
1) @Sam K. run canary and post p50/p95 snapshots at 5/15/60m (include cpu/mem on proxy).
2) @Elena G. run warmup+cache delta test and share p95 diff.
3) @Priya S. run the eval run 4532 and post quality deltas.
Rejoin in ~1h to decide fallback vs kernel tweak. Thanks :thumbsup:
